subject.title: Discord: Support messageUpdate and messageDelete events for edit-to-reprocess and delete-to-cancel

question: Should bundled Discord treat user message edits as replacement turns and source-message deletes as run cancellation by default?
rationale: Current code does not implement the behavior, and the requested semantics affect session state, message delivery, and operator expectations rather than being a narrow established bug contract.

options.title: Adopt linked PR semantics after live proof
options.body: Proceed with edit-to-reprocess and delete-to-cancel in the Discord plugin once https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/92091 proves the real gateway path and passes review.

options.title: Require opt-in handling
options.body: Ask the implementation to preserve current default behavior and gate edit/delete lifecycle changes behind an explicit Discord setting.

options.title: Defer to broader channel lifecycle design
options.body: Keep this issue open but pause the Discord-specific PR until maintainers define a cross-channel message edit/delete contract.

recommendation.title: Adopt linked PR semantics after live proof
recommendation.body: Proceed with edit-to-reprocess and delete-to-cancel in the Discord plugin once https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/92091 proves the real gateway path and passes review.

likelyOwner.reason: The relevant Discord listener/startup/queue code history points most strongly to steipete for the product and implementation boundary decision.
